question:
A vessel is in the form of a hollow hemisphere mounted on a hollow cylinder. The diameter of the hemisphere is 28 cm and the total height of the vessel is 26 cm, find the surface area of the vessel

(Take π = 22/7)
solution:
__**Calculation:**__

Radius of hemisphere = 14 cm

Height of the vessel = 26 cm

Curved surface area of hemisphere = 2 × π × radius²

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × 14 × 14 = 1232 cm²
